race.title: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: JAMINSKA has returned in top form and still looks on a handy mark after a 3 lb rise for her close second at Chepstow. She's preferred to Flash Man , who shaped well in a better race than this at the same meeting. JAMINSKA (FR) FLASH MAN (FR) EASTER ICON
race.bettingForecast: Jaminska (11/4), Rascallion (9/2), Flash Man (5/1), Easter Icon (5/1), Lady Magic (6/1), St Pancras (7/1), Macktoad (10/1)
